approval.instruction: 按最优值方案进行拍板把值更新任务策略与方案
approval.scope: Commercial-truth decision records, task strategy, queues and Harness prompts only; no production deployment is claimed by this record.
approval.numeric_value_policy: Existing K3 approvals and matching SKU data are inherited. This instruction does not fabricate new historical approvals for numbers.

global_rules.rule: A displayed price must bind SKU, specification, quantity, currency and effective date; otherwise remove the price hook and explain cost variables.
Proof, production, dispatch, transport and delivery are separate. Unverified timing is quote/order confirmation only.
No certificate file means no ZprintPro certification claim. Neutral regulatory education may remain; material compliance is confirmed at quote/order.
Remove unsourced orders, customers, institutions, satisfaction, ratios, capacity and delivery averages.
Remove unverified refund guarantees, free samples and satisfaction guarantees; do not substitute contact details for a policy.
For sku-seo-data.ts, edit zprintpro-sku-seo-data.csv and rerun node scripts/csv-to-sku-seo.mjs --apply; never hand-edit the derived file.
An experiment hold does not preserve known false claims. A truth fix is a separate deployment and resets its measurement baseline on the actual deploy date.
